evidence.title: Lawsuit accuses Dearborn, Michigan, of being 'hostile to Christians and Jews' with Islamic displays

occurrences.checkable_against: Dearborn Police Department merchandise records
occurrences.quote_span: "The police department was selling — with the police department's seal — Ramadan T-shirts. It had the police department seal and a crescent moon, and I believe it said Ramadan," Cleveland said.
occurrences.speaker: Margot Cleveland
occurrences.subject: Margot Cleveland lawsuit against Dearborn over public Islamic displays

occurrences.checkable_against: FOIA requests and Dearborn public-records responses
occurrences.quote_span: Cleveland submitted a series of Freedom of Information Act (FOIA) requests to find out the cost of the displays, which, according to her lawsuit and in an interview with Fox News Digital, is where she allegedly learned that the city had also integrated Islamic iconography in other official capacities.
occurrences.speaker: Fox News Digital
occurrences.subject: Margot Cleveland lawsuit against Dearborn over public Islamic displays

occurrences.checkable_against: Dearborn city council communications and instructions
occurrences.quote_span: After repeated attempts to try and contact city officials, Cleveland still received no response, until one city councilor told her that the council had been instructed not to engage with her.
occurrences.speaker: Fox News Digital
occurrences.subject: Margot Cleveland lawsuit against Dearborn over public Islamic displays

occurrences.checkable_against: Fox News Digital request and Dearborn city attorney response records
occurrences.quote_span: Dearborn’s city attorney did not respond to Fox News Digital's request for additional comments.
occurrences.speaker: Fox News Digital
occurrences.subject: Margot Cleveland lawsuit against Dearborn over public Islamic displays

occurrences.checkable_against: civil complaint filed by Margot Cleveland in the U.S. District Court for the Eastern District of Michigan
occurrences.quote_span: Margot Cleveland, senior legal correspondent at The Federalist, is suing the city of Dearborn, Michigan, and the city’s mayor, Abdullah Hammoud, for violating the First Amendment by displaying exclusively Muslim symbols in public displays, accusing the city of being "a hostile place for Christians and Jews."
occurrences.speaker: Margot Cleveland
occurrences.subject: Margot Cleveland lawsuit against Dearborn over public Islamic displays

occurrences.checkable_against: Fox News Digital inquiry and Dearborn Police Department response records
occurrences.quote_span: The Dearborn Police Department did not respond to a Fox News Digital inquiry regarding the alleged T-shirts.
occurrences.speaker: Fox News Digital
occurrences.subject: Margot Cleveland lawsuit against Dearborn over public Islamic displays

occurrences.checkable_against: Dearborn municipal procurement and display records
occurrences.quote_span: Contrary to acceding to her requests, Cleveland claims the city put up even more decorations celebrating Ramadan in the wake of her attempts to contact city officials.
occurrences.speaker: Margot Cleveland
occurrences.subject: Margot Cleveland lawsuit against Dearborn over public Islamic displays

occurrences.checkable_against: Dearborn official statement responding to the lawsuit
occurrences.quote_span: Dearborn "has a longstanding commitment to serving all residents fairly and equitably, regardless of faith or background," the statement read.
occurrences.speaker: City of Dearborn
occurrences.subject: Margot Cleveland lawsuit against Dearborn over public Islamic displays

occurrences.checkable_against: Dearborn city council meeting minutes and municipal budget records
occurrences.quote_span: She asked that the councilors, who she explained control the city’s purse strings, use an ongoing budget surplus to purchase banners celebrating Jewish and Christian holidays.
occurrences.speaker: Fox News Digital
occurrences.subject: Margot Cleveland lawsuit against Dearborn over public Islamic displays

occurrences.checkable_against: Dearborn public display records and Cleveland's civil complaint
occurrences.quote_span: Cleveland alleges the city put up banners celebrating the Islamic holiday of Ramadan and a display of crescent moons while refusing to showcase equivalent Christian or Jewish iconography.
occurrences.speaker: Margot Cleveland
occurrences.subject: Margot Cleveland lawsuit against Dearborn over public Islamic displays

occurrences.checkable_against: Fox News Digital request and Dearborn mayor's office response records
occurrences.quote_span: The mayor’s office did not respond to a Fox News request for comment.
occurrences.speaker: Fox News Digital
occurrences.subject: Margot Cleveland lawsuit against Dearborn over public Islamic displays

occurrences.checkable_against: Cleveland's communications with Dearborn and Dearborn public display records
occurrences.quote_span: "I have not asked the city not to celebrate Ramadan," she said. "What I've asked is that the city treat Christians and Jews equally. Put up Passover banners, Easter banners, put up a Star of David, put up a cross, do something. And throw in some patriotic symbols to show we are one Dearborn, one country where all faiths are represented equally. That has not been done," she said.
occurrences.speaker: Margot Cleveland
occurrences.subject: Margot Cleveland lawsuit against Dearborn over public Islamic displays

occurrences.checkable_against: Dearborn official statement responding to the lawsuit
occurrences.quote_span: "Dearborn will continue to uphold the rights and dignity of every resident and remain a city where everyone is treated with fairness, respect, and equal protection under the law," the statement continued.
occurrences.speaker: City of Dearborn
occurrences.subject: Margot Cleveland lawsuit against Dearborn over public Islamic displays

occurrences.checkable_against: City council email records and LinkedIn message
occurrences.quote_span: "I reached out to city council, every individual, both their public email and a secondary one. Received no response," she shared. "But on LinkedIn, one of the council members responded and said, ‘Hey, we were told we can't talk to you,’" Cleveland told Fox News Digital.
occurrences.speaker: Margot Cleveland
occurrences.subject: Margot Cleveland lawsuit against Dearborn over public Islamic displays

occurrences.checkable_against: Dearborn public display records and the 2026 religious calendar
occurrences.quote_span: "This was the fourth week of Lent. We had Easter coming up in two weeks, and Passover was a week away. I was shocked, and then I saw the display all by itself — again, the crescent moon," she said.
occurrences.speaker: Margot Cleveland
occurrences.subject: Margot Cleveland lawsuit against Dearborn over public Islamic displays

occurrences.checkable_against: Dearborn municipal display records and photographs
occurrences.quote_span: "I was picking up pizza in downtown Dearborn. When I went down the boulevard, up and down the street were ‘Ramadan Kareem’ (generous Ramadan) banners, which is the equivalent of a happy or blessed Ramadan," Cleveland told Fox News Digital in an exclusive interview.
occurrences.speaker: Margot Cleveland
occurrences.subject: Margot Cleveland lawsuit against Dearborn over public Islamic displays

occurrences.checkable_against: Dearborn city attorney correspondence records
occurrences.quote_span: Cleveland wrote to Dearborn’s city attorney, asking if the city planned to reciprocate the displays for the other Abrahamic faiths, but did not get a response, she told Fox News Digital.
occurrences.speaker: Margot Cleveland
occurrences.subject: Margot Cleveland lawsuit against Dearborn over public Islamic displays

occurrences.checkable_against: Dearborn procurement records and public display photographs
occurrences.quote_span: "After I was ignored, what happened? The mayor then went and bought more Ramadan displays. I complained about the banners. What does he go? He goes bigger and brighter with lighted Ramadan displays," she said.
occurrences.speaker: Margot Cleveland
occurrences.subject: Margot Cleveland lawsuit against Dearborn over public Islamic displays

occurrences.checkable_against: U.S. District Court for the Eastern District of Michigan civil docket and complaint
occurrences.quote_span: The American Freedom Law Center filed the civil complaint on behalf of Cleveland in the United States District Court for the Eastern District of Michigan on Sept. 17.
occurrences.speaker: Fox News Digital
occurrences.subject: Margot Cleveland lawsuit against Dearborn over public Islamic displays

occurrences.checkable_against: Dearborn city council meeting minutes and video
occurrences.quote_span: Cleveland then attended an open city council meeting in May.
occurrences.speaker: Fox News Digital
occurrences.subject: Margot Cleveland lawsuit against Dearborn over public Islamic displays

occurrences.checkable_against: Dearborn official statement responding to the lawsuit
occurrences.quote_span: The city rejected Cleveland's accusations in a statement released shortly after Cleveland's lawsuit.
occurrences.speaker: Fox News Digital
occurrences.subject: Margot Cleveland lawsuit against Dearborn over public Islamic displays
